items.title: Alton Purnell Interview, 1958-08-29
items.q: He was a very good musician but he played nice. His name was Plutsem... He taught me a whole lot on piano.

ctx.x: Where was it that you finally evened up the sky?

In one of the ballrooms I walked in and he was sitting down playing you know. I'd say get up man, you don't know how to play. He was so surprised. Also I had another fellow who taught me a lot on the piano. He was a very good musician but he played nice. His name was Plutsem. Plutsem? Yeah. His last name was Johnson. But we used to call him Plutsem. He was hunchback. And he taught me a whole lot on piano. Well I wish I would continue learning because now that I'm playing I'm a little handicapped in some of the…
When you were a kid did you ever have a piano in your home to practice?
